        ai_chance = { base = 60 modifier = { factor = 0 gold < oe_itp_due } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.1.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.1.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_hg value = 2 }
            random = { chance = oe_itp_haggle_ch set_variable = { name = oe_itp_hg value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_hg ?= 1 }
                c:VEN = { set_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
                oe_itp_pact_renewed = yes
                trigger_event_silently = oe_itp.99
            }
            else = {
                oe_itp_pact_renewed = yes
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 24 }
                oe_itp_add_claims = { kd = 5 }
            }
            c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_haggled target = c:BYZ } }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 25 modifier = { factor = 2 has_variable = oe_itp_hgch var:oe_itp_hgch >= 50 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.1.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.1.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            set_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven mode = replace }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 24 }
            c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_lapsed target = c:BYZ } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven } }
                random = {
                    chance = 15
                    oe_itp_rep_set_ven = yes
                    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_why_ven value = 2 }
                    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_ven }
                }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 modifier = { factor = 0 gold >= oe_itp_due3 } }

        name = oe_itp.1.d
